title: Idiosyncratic Volatility and Survival Conditioning: A Matched-Convention Comparison of Biased and Delisting-Inclusive US Equity Panels — Replication Package
description: Replication code and derived-data aggregates for a study comparing idiosyncratic volatility estimates between a current-constituent S&P 500 panel and a delisting-inclusive full-universe panel of 12,449 firms constructed from Sharadar SF1. The two panels differ significantly under a matched convention, but the corrected panel's own estimate is an imprecise near-zero rather than a confirmed zero, and a survival-conditioning ladder initially read as independent confirmation of the survivorship mechanism is shown to be predominantly a birth-cohort artifact. Raw third-party fundamental data (Sharadar SF1) are not redistributed in this deposit; the derived-data directory contains only cross-sectional aggregates (regression coefficients, portfolio-mean returns, and summary panels). See README.md for full data-access terms and a table-to-script mapping.
